ED launches probe into TMC funds, raids multiple locations in Bengal

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has launched a probe into alleged irregularities in the financial transactions of the Trinamool Congress (TMC), raiding multiple locations in West Bengal. The ED's actions come amid allegations of money laundering and corruption linked to the TMC. The raids are part of an ongoing investigation into the party's alleged misuse of funds.
